title: Heavy impact drop
prompt: A 3-second cinematic heavy impact centred on low C, built for trailer-style drops. It opens on a dark, distant rumble that slowly swells. From 1.0 s a reversed "pre-suck" pulls the air inwards: reversed dark noise and a reversed metal shimmer rise as their filter opens. The suck cuts off 60 ms before the hit and leaves a short vacuum. On frame 45 (1.5 s) everything lands at once. A mono sub boom drops in pitch from about 130 Hz down to C1, with a C2 octave for small speakers. A sharp transient crack and a chesty body thump hit with it. A clangy, inharmonic metal-plate ring on C beats and fades. A dark, wide noise and reverb tail rolls off over about 1.5 s. The sub boom is the only content below 120 Hz, and it is mono.
notes: Dark rumble swell, then a reversed noise + metal-shimmer pre-suck (TPT low-pass opening) that cuts with a 3 ms fade 60 ms before frame 45, leaving a vacuum. Impact: mono sub boom sweeping ~130 Hz -> C1 with a C2 layer, broadband transient crack, 140-450 Hz body thump, detuned inharmonic plate ring on C4/C3, closing-low-pass noise tail and a dark 2.2 s hall. Only the sub sits below 120 Hz; limiter followed by an 18 Hz DC block.
